desc: t

The Thai people migrated from South China to Indochina centuries ago, where they discovered a land crossed by trade and influences from both India and China. Drinking from both sources, as well as from the presence of Hinduism and Buddhism, the Thai developed its own unique identity, creating polities that are able to stand on equal footing to those by the former rulers, the Mon people, who have seen their territory reduced and many of their old kingdoms supplanted by Thai ones. This has also caused the Empire of Khmer to slip into decline, and they have subsequently lost much of its previous influence. Only time can tell to what further heights the Thai will be able to reach.

One of the Mon kingdoms that suffered a downfall was Lavo, which was not only conquered by the Thai but also split into the Thai kingdoms of Suphanburi and Lavo. The latter, although they retained their name from the Mon period, was under Thai rule, which was itself under the suzerainty of the Empire of Khmer.

However, Empire of Khmer has waned in power in recent years, which not only enabled the creation of an independent Kingdom of Sukhothai, but also allowed Lavo to remove its shackles. In the midst of these nascent independent kingdoms, the developing settlement of Ayodhya also shows promise of expansion. The opportunity for great change has finally appeared to us.

desc: t

The Crown of Aragon stands proudly as a significant power in the western Mediterranean region, thanks to its maritime prowess, diplomatic weight, and flourishing trade networks.

The stabilization of the Kingdom of Valencia and the ongoing conquest of the newly-created Kingdom of Sardinia and Corsica might ensure its dominance of the seas. However, despite its relative stability, challenges loom on the horizon. To the East, the Kingdom of Mallorca faces economic difficulties, and its ruler's animosity towards Aragon might lead to conflict. In the peninsula, the threat of the Crown of Castile is becoming more and more real as the ''Reconquista'' comes to an end. To the north, the Kingdom of France have consolidated their dominion over the Languedoc in the last century.

How should the young Aragon face the challenges to come? Will Aragon focus on the Mediterranean Sea and rule the waves from Barcelona to the Holy Land? Will Aragon turn around and claim dominance over Iberia? Or will Aragon try to get revenge for the Battle of Muret in 1213, and recover long-lost ancient holdings north of the Pyrenees?

desc: t

Armenian people have been living in these lands since antiquity, their nation having originated at the foot of Mount Ararat. Fiercely proud of having been the first nation to embrace Christianity, they have survived invasions from Islam, Persia, and Turkic peoples, although they have seen themselves divided into multiple smaller kingdoms, and the glory of the great Armenian kingdom of the past is long gone.

However, Armenian people are resilient, and even after the recent Mongol invasions they survive, waiting for the moment to rise again. Although the County of Armenia finds itself currently under the authority of the Kingdom of Georgia, and also the Īlkhānān, it still has enough autonomy to act independently. Despite being a shadow of the former Armenian glory, the ruling Zakarid dynasty has managed to reestablish a consolidation of their rule, and continue standing proudly among the nations of the world.

desc: t

The Heartland of the Holy Roman Empire has endured the long period of the Great Interregnum, and looks to the future with grave concern. In the face of Ubv Ludwig IV Wittelsbach's advancing age, the families of Upper Bavaria, Bohemia, and Austria once more prepare for competition over the crown. While Imperial authority south of the Alps is deteriorating, German merchants scramble to secure their trade routes into Italy, as the Duchy of Hansa relish their dominance over the region of Northern Germany.

The County of Brandenburg was established as the ''Northern March'' in the Slavic Wends' territory. The region features loamy uplands and depressions with abundant water and pine trees, heat, and dry, sandy soil, earning it the nickname  'the sandbox of the Holy Roman Empire'.

In 1157, after claiming these lands from Jaxa of Köpenick, Bra Albrecht I Askanier officially became Brandenburg. Initially limited to Havelland and Zauche, he encouraged the ''Ostsiedlung'''s process towards the Neumark east of the Oder, gradually incorporating it into his possessions. Colonists coming from Flanders and the Rhineland were invited to settle, fortifying their towns in the process.

After his death in 1170, the Askanier dynasty continued this expansion for over 150 years, acquiring neighboring regions like the Oder Lagoon and the Uckermark, which expanded their influence to the Baltic Sea. Unfortunately, this led to conflict with Denmark. However, the last Askanier, Bra Heinrich II Askanier, died without a direct heir in 1320.

Now, the Wittelsbach dynasty has arrived, but their lack of interest in ruling these lands casts a shadow over the future of the County of Brandenburg.
entities.name: Brandenburg

desc: t

The nations in the Low Countries have been bounded and bossed around by both the Kingdom of France or the Holy Roman Empire since their creation, often becoming a fief of one or the other and not rarely switching sides. Like a big prize waiting for a claimant, as one of the richest regions in Europe, the countries of the region are in a position where they have to decide whether they will become an integral part of other nations or will defend their independence with fury.

Being one of the biggest and most populated nation in the Low Countries, we are obviously best suited to lead our neighbors, especially taking into account the weak position the Duchy of Flanders is in. Should we strike at the precise moment, we could elevate ourselves to the highest echelons, as we deserve...
entities.name: Brabant

desc: t

Once a proud Byzantium that stretched from Egypt and the Levant to Iberia and Italy, Byzantium now faces a period of almost inexorable decline caused by the shock of the Fourth Crusade, even after the recovery of Constantinople by the Byzantium. During Byz Andronikos II Palaiologos reign, Byz Andronikos II Palaiologos saw fit to dissolve several key institutions, such as the Navy, in an attempt to save the dying economy of the country, while the Decayed Theme System continued to be a shadow of what it was, as the Byzantium lost territory across all fronts.

Byz Andronikos II Palaiologos successor, Byz Andronikos III Palaiologos, is now faced with the difficult task of safeguarding what remains of our once-glorious Byzantium. To our east, Ottomans have started amassing a large army to wipe out our remaining holdings in Anatolia, threatening to set foot across the straits. At the same time, Ser Stefan Dusan eyes Thessaloníki and Northern Epirus like a vulture. Meanwhile, our treasury runs dry of precious coin, and the country may yet be thrown into a perilous civil war, as the family of our Byzantium conspires with the Byzantium behind closed doors. Can the Byzantium lift this once-great nation from the ashes?

desc: t

The Crown of Castile was formed through the union of its two constituent parts, the Kingdom of Castile and the Kingdom of León, when they were reunited after both titles were inherited by Cas Fernando III Burgundy in 1230. A century later, Cas Alfonso XI Burgundy rules without much opposition, having overcome a troubled start to his reign following the end of a long regency under his grandmother, Cas Maria Molina.

After reining in the nobility of the realm, led by his relative Cas Juan Manuel, and having stabilized the governance of the country, Cas Alfonso XI Burgundy is now turning his attention to the southern border. The Duchy of Granada has menaced our country since the emirate became independent a century ago, backed by the powerful Kingdom of Morocco, which has a foothold on Iberia through a petty kingdom centered on Algeciras and Ronda, and held by Mor Abu Malik Abd Al Wahid, son and heir of Mor Abu Al Hasan Ali.

However, these are not the only troubles for Cas Alfonso XI Burgundy, as his relationship with his beloved mistress, Cas Leonor Guzman, and Cas Alfonso XI Burgundy children by Cas Leonor Guzman have eroded the relationship with the king's actual wife, Cas Maria Portugal, daughter of Por Afonso IV Portugal. With the latter living apart from the Castile, this rift in the royal family now leaves the looming question of just who will succeed him when he passes.

Will Cas Alfonso XI Burgundy and his successors be able to deal with these threats to the Crown of Castile, both at home and abroad?
entities.name: Castile

Champa is a collection of many different, somewhat autonomous Cham polities which have united to form a single Champa. As the only Hinduism state in mainland Indochina, the people of the Kingdom of Champa face constant threat from the decaying Empire of Khmer to their west and the aggressive Kingdom of Đại Việt to their north. Despite these external threats, the seafaring acumen of the Champa people has allowed them to amass wealth and power over the seas of Indonesia.

Once a conglomerate of disparate groups, Champa has blossomed into a sophisticated force to be reckoned with, but will it take its rightful place as the ruler of all nations?

desc: t

The great Genghis Khan Khān forged an empire of unparalleled strength and ambition for all Mongol peoples, bringing into his fold great swathes of land from Europe to China. People everywhere learned to fear the sound of the Mongol armies galloping through, and the might and power of the Great Khān.

As heirs of this legacy, our dream of restoring the glory of the greatest Mongol Horde burns passionately within us all.

chagatai_khan was the son of Genghis Khān, and therefore the heir to his legacy and empire.

Chagatai's situation at the center of the different Mongol states is of great importance, as the Silk Road crosses through our lands, and many of its most important cities are under our control. That puts Chagatai in the best position to control trade and communication between the other heirs of the Great Khān. And if any of those other heirs objects, we shall deal with them... decisively.

However, their influence over the subcontinent is waning. Internal strife, instability, and cultural friction have corroded what once was prosperous and magnificent, and those who wish to dethrone the China and usurp their mandate are gathering their strength. Plotting and scheming within China's borders, these traitors seek to find every possible weakness within the Empire's rule, vying for scraps of power and a passing mention in the scrolls of history. But while many may struggle and die for the honor, only one leader can sit on the Dragon Throne and fulfill the will of Heaven.

The Town of Cahokia, a settlement built on a confluence of sacred rivers and blessed with fertile lands, has grown and evolved into a complex society. Life in Cahokia revolves around the cultivation of the surrounding fertile valley, where the Three Sisters — maize, beans, and squash — grow tall, and around bowing to the rule of the Cahokia, who are prolific builders of temples. The culture of Cahokia has spread throughout the surrounding area, creating a vast sphere of influence and drawing new residents from around the region.

Given our strictly organized society and highly influential culture, we have risen to a position most other peoples can only dream of. However, we may yet face insurmountable, unforeseeable threats. Will we be able to further build and develop our society, or will our glories be lost, and forgotten forever?

Guided by the sun god, Inti, the first of our leaders founded Qusqu on the precise spot where his golden staff sank into the earth. After centuries of living alongside other groups, the inca_culture finally achieved dominance, and we established ourselves as the scions of this beautiful place. The high volcanoes and rushing rivers of the Andes Mountains shelter and nourish the Sacred Valley of the Incas, where we, the sons of the Sun, dwell in our magnificent city and make ready for the glorious future awaiting us. From our towering bulwark of mountains to our bountiful terraced farmlands, other nations can only gaze in envy at our riches.

After years of power consolidation and politics, the time has come for our people to expand their influence outside our precious valley; to defeat our enemies and follow the paths of the mountains until we stand in each corner of this world. Are we prepared to face this destiny? Or will our enemies defeat us before we can reach our prime?

Rising from the aftermath of a civil war with the Ngô dynasty in 968, the Kingdom of Đại Việt has struggled ever since against the Chinese Empire's rapidly expanding sphere of influence to the north. Although part of the Middle Kingdom, the Đại Việt people have had to defend their lands from Yuán(CHI) invaders on multiple occasions, breeding powerful, long-lasting resentments.

Aide from external threats, the Đại Việt also faces the problems caused by a highly decentralized state, with the additional challenges brought by both Autonomous Villages, and a volatile court life where hostile actors constantly seek to seize the Đại Việt throne.

Despite all these obstacles, Đại Việt finds itself in an opportunistic situation, as the Kingdom of Champa is surrounded by enemies and ripe for the taking, and Khmer faces internal decay at every front. This must be a sign that the ascension of the Đại Việt to become the mightiest empire in Indochina is finally at hand!

desc: t

Long a powerful player on the world stage, the Kingdom of Denmark now finds itself in quite a precarious situation. During the previous rule of Dan Chistopher II, large portions of the country were mortgaged to prominent members of the Danish and German Nobility, the Duchy of Schleswig was forcibly separated from the crown lands, and even the territory of Scania had to be sold to the Kingdom of Sweden. This shameful state of affairs worsened when Dan Chistopher II was dethroned by Shl Gerhard III Holstein Rendsburg after installing his own nephew Dan Valdemar III on the throne, only to ultimately be brought back again as a puppet king. Since Dan Chistopher II's death, Shl Gerhard III Holstein Rendsburg has been the de facto ruler of Denmark.

It will not be easy to overcome this situation, but Danish are resilient and resolute, and Dan Valdemar Atterdag, son of Dan Chistopher II is already crafting a plan to recover the authority of the Denmark. Whether it will be successful or not remains to be seen.
entities.name: Denmark

desc: t

The County of Durham is no ordinary lordship, but a Durham under the Kingdom of England, where the Durham rules with near-regal authority. Entrusted with powers to raise armies, mint coinage, and administer justice, the Bishop of Durham acts as a temporal prince over his domain in Northumbria.

For generations, this exceptional autonomy has allowed the bishops to guard the northern frontier from Scottish raids, their fortified seat at Durham a bastion of loyalty amidst the marches.

Yet the times are uncertain. The border grows restless, Scotland remains hostile, and even amongst the Durham, murmurs of reform and ambition stir. Though cloaked in sacred robes, the Durham of Durham stands as a political creature — and one who may yet rise to play a greater role in the affairs of the realm.

Will the Durham remain a quiet corner of royal service, or could it become a power in its own right, a great northern kingdom in all but name?

desc: t

A series of swift and decisive conquests in the last century gave birth to our great Kingdom of Delhi. With territories under our jurisdiction spanning from from Deccan to the fertile fields of Lahore, no other civilization can match our prestigious accomplishments.

However, it has become apparent that we have overextended our authority across such a vast Delhi; it is becoming increasingly difficult to control nowadays. Our enemies are many, and they seek to nullify our superior heritage and sophisticated culture. To the east, our subjects in Bengal have started questioning their masters, while our southern territories have long disputed our hold over them. And the Hinduism countries of Southern India may further entrench their resistance to our rule, led by the rising power of Vijayanagar.

While this situation feels precarious, we trust the guidance of Dlh Muhammad Bin Tughluq, whose watchful eye may safeguard our lands against threats, and thus prevent our downfall...
entities.name: Delhi

desc: t

The County of Desmond lies in the rugged southwestern reaches of Ireland. Though far from Dublin, it is no remote backwater — it is ruled by Dms Maurice Fitzgerald, 1st Earl of Desmond, head of the southern branch of the mighty Fitzgerald, and one of the most powerful lords in all of Ireland.

Granted his earldom in 1329, he carved out a semi-independent domain from the Gaelic chiefs of Thomond and the English crown authority of Pale.

The Earldom is marked by shifting alliances, rival marcher barons, and persistent tension with both Dublin and London. As English royal power wanes in the west, we may seize the opportunity to assert autonomy, play the Gaelic clans against each other, or even claim kingship in all but name.

Will Desmond become a linchpin of a new Hiberno-Norman resurgence? Or will it be swallowed by the tide of Gaelic reconquest and the feuds of rival dynasties?
entities.name: Desmond

desc: t

The English crown is still reeling from the treacherous rebellion that occurred ten year prior and resulted in the underhanded assassination of Eng Edward II. Although the ringleaders were executed, several co-conspirators have been granted mercy in the name of peace — a peace which could easily be shattered at any moment.

Meanwhile, Eng Edward II's surviving heir, Eng Edward III, has already proven to be a capable young ruler, and is making bold designs on the French throne — a throne which is his birthright as the grandson of a Capet ruler.

In the north, the misguided Balliol weakly contends for the Scottish crown, while our loyal vassals maintain a tight grip on the governments of Wales, Pale, and Aquitaine.

How shall we brave the turbulent years to come? Will we cross the channel and become a continental power, or should we look to the seas for global dominion?

desc: t

The Empire of Ethiopia is an ancient land rich with history and traditions. Nestled in the Horn of Africa, it boasts lush highlands, windswept plateaus, and the incomparable Great Rift Valley. Newcomers are captivated by its beauty, entranced by the golden sunsets against the Simien Mountains.

Ethiopia's enchanting tapestry weaves together diverse ethnic groups like the Amhara, Afar, and Tigre. United by trials, Ethiopia remains resilient like an ancient baobab tree, enduring through time.

Inspired by these ancient origins, Ethiopia cherishes legendary unions like that of the Queen of Sheba and King Solomon. The legacy of their son Menelik, the first member of the Solomon dynasty, echoes through the ages, connecting people of this land to the ancient Israelites.

Through the years, Ethiopia's epic tale unfolds, shaped by destiny and the unwavering spirit of its people. Triumphs and tribulations weave a rich tapestry of life's ebb and flow.

However, this nation is a realm encircled by adversaries who eagerly await any opportunity to strike. Managing not only to survive, but thrive, will be a challenge.
entities.name: Ethiopia

desc: t

Nestled in the borderlands between Wales and the heartlands of the Kingdom of England, the County of Ewyas holds a vital strategic position as one of the marcher lordships charged with securing the realm's western frontier.

The current ruler, Eng Bartholomew Burghersh The Elder, is a loyal servant of the Crown and a veteran of both war and courtly life. A trusted retainer of Eng Edward III, he has proven himself not only on the battlefield, but also as a royal envoy and administrator, serving at times as Constable of Dover and Warden of the Cinque Ports. His landed authority in the Marches gives him both wealth and reach, though he remains ever vigilant against the shifting loyalties and ambitions that define the region.

Will the Burghersh line maintain its favor with the Burghersh and guard the Marches with honor? Or will the shifting tides of politics, war, and inheritance sweep away this marcher stronghold?
entities.name: Ewyas

desc: t

The nations in the Low Countries have been bounded and bossed around by both the Kingdom of France or the Holy Roman Empire since their creation, often becoming a fief of one or the other and not rarely switching sides. Like a big prize waiting for a claimant, as one of the richest regions in Europe, the countries of the region are in a position where they have to decide whether they will become an integral part of other nations or will defend their independence with fury.

The Franco-Flemish war, which lasted from 1297 to 1305, deeply impacted Duchy of Flanders. While we managed to stay independent, our struggle culminated with the loss of the Roman Flanders to Kingdom of France.

As one of the richest nations in the region, Flanders has recovered in the past few years, and we might now have the opportunity to reclaim what it is rightfully ours.
entities.name: Flanders

The Florentine domain stands strong at the cusp of a new age! Our republic has stood the test of time and is located in a prime position to take advantage of our region's prosperity and affluence. Around us, rival states and potential allies all make their moves in a bid to influence and expand their territories in Italy.

However, few are as well known for their aptitude in arts and cultural influence as those in our forums of thought in Florence. Under the guidance of a capable administration and an educated population, the coming century will elevate our people and have us shine brightly as pioneering innovators during a time of great enlightenment. Provided we establish ourselves as such, of course...

desc: t

The death of Fra Charles IV Capet without a male heir in 1328 marked the end of Capet rule over the Kingdom of France, resulting in the coronation of Fra Philip VI Valois, a relative from a former cadet branch of the dynasty. However, this claim has been contested by Eng Edward III of England, on the pretext that while the Salic Law of France forbids the passing of the throne to a female successor, it does not forbid inheritance through a female line. As the son of Eng Isabella Of France, the last living sibling of Fra Charles IV Capet, Eng Edward III might claim the throne of France as his birthright.

The tension between both countries has worsened over the past years, as our hospitality of the exiled young ruler of Scotland, Sco David II, has enraged the English court, which supports the rival Balliol claimant to the Scottish throne. As a response, Eng Edward III has also recently granted refuge to Eng Robert III Artois, who escaped calls to face trial in Paris for his attempts to seize the County of Artois. There are rumors that Eng Robert III Artois is even encouraging the disgruntled Eng Edward III to press his claim to the throne of France militarily.

Should relations reach a boiling point, Fra Philip VI Valois may require the support of Fra Philip VI Valois subjects, although more than one ambitious Appanage hailing from the old royal line may seize the opportunity to demand greater privileges, proving a greater threat to the stability of the crown than any invading claimant. The upcoming years will be consequential for the future of France, having to face external English menace and the proud French lords at once. Will the country fall to the fake pretenders, or emerge as the main power in Europe?
entities.name: France

desc: t

The nations in the Low Countries have been bounded and bossed around by both the Kingdom of France or the Holy Roman Empire since their creation, often becoming a fief of one or the other and not rarely switching sides. Like a big prize waiting for a claimant, as one of the richest regions in Europe, the countries of the region are in a position where they have to decide whether they will become an integral part of other nations or will defend their independence with fury.

Encircled by feudal lords, our society is currently divided between those who wish to retain our independence, and those that are slowly gaining power by adopting the foreign ways of the neighboring nations. The County of Frisia has therefore arrived at a crossroads, while still dreaming of our past glory. Are we finally ready to step forward and declare ourselves for one side or the other?
entities.name: Frisia

desc: t

The city of Genoa stands out as the most important commercial port in the Western Mediterranean, its Genoa having greatly expanded its influence overseas through trade and war.

After defeating the County of Pisa, it gained the island of Corsica and established a foothold in Sardinia. However, this might have been a poisonous gift, as Genoa may now face not only opposition from its inhabitants, but also from Ara Peter IV Arago, self-proclaimed sovereign of both islands.

Another challenge could arise from the east, as our wide network has created the conditions for commercial dominance over the Black Sea, centered around the port of Kaffa, although dangerous neighbors such as Venice, Byzantium, or the Kingdom of Jochi might be a threat.

Relying on our numerous Fondaco and wealthy bankers, will Genoa be able to overcome these challenges?

desc: t

Georgian people are proud of their long history, for their ancestors were already living at the foot of the Caucasus before the empires of antiquity were even founded. They were among the first to embrace Christianity, and embraced the faith as part of their identity. Even after the expansion of Islam, and becoming surrounded by heathen nations, they held on to their faith and became a bulwark of Christianity on the border between the East and the West.

Not even the Mongol hordes of Genghis Khan Khān managed to fully subjugate the Georgian people, for they rose again in defiance once the Mongol threat waned.

Having been united once before under a great kingdom, the Georgian people now have the potential to achieve legendary heights once again.

We achieved our most splendid accomplishments during the rule of Geo David IV and Geo Tamar The Great. Now, after having been divided for too long, the Kingdom of Georgia is once again united under the authority of Geo George V, after Geo George V conquered western Georgia and reasserted Geo George V rule over all the Georgian territory. Even Armenia bows now to the power of Georgia.

Although still technically subject to the Īlkhānān, they are greatly fractured, and Georgia finds itself within an empty husk, waiting for a strong leader to rise from within and take control. Under these circumstances, how could Georgia not be reborn greater than ever before?
entities.name: Georgia

desc: t

The great Genghis Khan Khān forged an empire of unparalleled strength and ambition for all Mongol peoples, bringing into his fold great swathes of land from Europe to China. People everywhere learned to fear the sound of the Mongol armies galloping through, and the might and power of the Great Khān.

As heirs of this legacy, our dream of restoring the glory of the greatest Mongol Horde burns passionately within us all. It was jochi_borjigin, son of Genghis Khān, and his son batu_borjigin who carried on the legacy of the Great Khān and established the Kingdom of Jochi.

Controlling the westernmost expansion of the great empire, we are the rulers of the vast steppes. Many nations in Europe  are subservient to us, afraid of our legendary might. As they should be...

The Heartland of the Holy Roman Empire has endured the long period of the Great Interregnum, and looks to the future with grave concern. In the face of Ubv Ludwig IV Wittelsbach's advancing age, the families of Upper Bavaria, Bohemia, and Austria once more prepare for competition over the crown. While Imperial authority south of the Alps is deteriorating, German merchants scramble to secure their trade routes into Italy, as the Duchy of Hansa relish their dominance over the region of Northern Germany.

With their position on the south-eastern borders of the Holy Roman Empire secured, Austria can now look towards the grand prize the Habsburg are determined to reclaim: the imperial crown of the Holy Roman Empire.

For centuries, the great Kingdom of Hungary has defended this bastion of Catholicism from the pagans and heathens that threaten beyond. Recent rebellions amongst the Hungary put this duty in danger, but thanks to the iron hand of Hungary, the disgruntled Hungary have been reined in, and the Hungarian faith has been renewed and reinforced.

What fate awaits the Kingdom of Hungary? Will it fall to the enemies of the righteous? Or will it stand proud before the onslaught of those who seek its demise?

After a long period of peace under the Kamakura Shogunate, the islands of Japan were plunged again into war during the Mongol invasions. That debilitated the authority of the Shōgun to the point where Daikakuji was able to wrest control of the country away from him. However, Daikakuji intentions of restoring Imperial rule were not to come to fruition, as Daikakuji former ally Ashikaga(JAP) established a new Japanese Shogunate instead.

Now Ashikaga(JAP) rules over the country after Daikakuji fled the capital and established Daikakuji in Daikakuji. However, the struggle between the central government and the fleeing Emperor is far from over...

desc: t

The Knights Hospitaller conquered the island of Ródos in the early 14th century, spurred by the fall of Acre in 1291, and established a stronghold that would aid us in our mission to protect Christianity pilgrims. Ródos, a picturesque island in the Aegean Sea, has become a thriving center for our Military Order, distinguished by towering fortifications and a bustling economy. However, this prosperity is somewhat countered by relentless attacks from neighboring Islam fleets. But we have demonstrated remarkable resilience, defending Ródos through ferocious battles that showcased our martial prowess and unwavering dedication.

Nonetheless, the future of our Order looks bleak, as our enemies grow ever more powerful, and the disunity among the Catholicism countries runs rampant. Recovering the Holy Land seems to be a fading hope with each passing day, but our determination is unbreakable, and we will pursue that objective until our last man falls.

Art, literacy, diplomacy, and unwavering faith flourished during this legendary time, forever changing the cultural landscape of Korea.

Even after bending to kublai_khan, Goryeo continues to be an significant power, both due to its highly educated population and its mighty naval force.

Now the winds of change are blowing, as the corruption of Buddhism ideals and the galvanizing, revolutionary ideas of Neo-Confucianism are changing minds all over the country. Will Goryeo transform into the strongest soldier in China's army, or will it break free from those shackles and dictate its future?

desc: t

The Thai people migrated from South China to Indochina centuries ago, where they discovered a land crossed by trade and influences from both India and China. Drinking from both sources, as well as from the presence of Hinduism and Buddhism, the Thai developed its own unique identity, creating polities that are able to stand on equal footing to those by the former rulers, the Mon people, who have seen their territory reduced and many of their old kingdoms supplanted by Thai ones. This has also caused the Empire of Khmer to slip into decline, and they have subsequently lost much of its previous influence. Only time can tell to what further heights the Thai will be able to reach.

One of the Mon kingdoms that suffered a downfall was Lavo, which was not only conquered by the Thai but also split into the Thai kingdoms of Suphanburi and Lavo. The latter, although they retained their name from the Mon period, was under Thai rule, which was itself under the suzerainty of the Empire of Khmer.

However, Empire of Khmer has waned in power in recent years, which not only enabled the creation of an independent Kingdom of Sukhothai, but also allowed Lavo to remove its shackles. In the midst of these nascent independent kingdoms, the developing settlement of Ayodhya also shows promise of expansion. The opportunity for great change has finally appeared to us.

The nations in the Low Countries have been bounded and bossed around by both the Kingdom of France or the Holy Roman Empire since their creation, often becoming a fief of one or the other and not rarely switching sides. Like a big prize waiting for a claimant, as one of the richest regions in Europe, the countries of the region are in a position where they have to decide whether they will become an integral part of other nations or will defend their independence with fury.

The homeland of many religious leaders, the Duchy of Liège is clearly the spiritual guide of the Low Countries. Our nation is a center of education of the highest degree, and therefore wields powerful influence over neighboring states. This influence will certainly ensure our ascent as a nation, should we use it wisely.

Situated between the lands of Poland and the mighty Kingdom of Jochi, the Duchy of Lithuania have a proud history as one of the last bastions of Paganism. Under the Gediminid dynasty, the Lithuanian people have tasted success by expanding their domain to envelop parts of the Kievan Rus'. However, growing pressure and an ongoing crusade spearheaded by the Duchy of Teutons, the Duchy of Livonia and the Bohemia of Bohemia serve as grave reminders that religious friction may yet contribute to their demise. Various attempts to embrace the Catholicism faith have proven unsuccessful, and rising tensions across our borders threaten our stability. It is in this tense and precarious environment that we must determine our next steps...

desc: t

The nations in the Low Countries have been bounded and bossed around by both the Kingdom of France or the Holy Roman Empire since their creation, often becoming a fief of one or the other and not rarely switching sides. Like a big prize waiting for a claimant, as one of the richest regions in Europe, the countries of the region are in a position where they have to decide whether they will become an integral part of other nations or will defend their independence with fury.

The original home of the luxembourg_dynasty dynasty, the County of Luxembourg is a mere shadow compared to the holdings controlled by the most powerful branches of our family. However, given the prestige that our kin has earned, we may yet find an opportunity to seize control over the region, and unite it all under our rule.
entities.name: Luxembourg

desc: t

The County of March, ruled by the ambitious Mortimer dynasty, is one of the most powerful marcher lordships straddling the border between Wales and the Kingdom of England.

Once elevated to near-royal power, the late Eng Roger Mortimer 1St Earl Of March held England in his grasp as its England, a post he achieved by treacherously having Eng Edward II assassinated. But ambition proved fatal — he was overthrown in 1330 and executed, the Mortimer name forever blackened as a family of usurpers and traitors.

Now, the young Eng Roger Mortimer 2Nd Earl Of March, heir to this disgraced line, stands to inherit not only vast estates and marcher prestige, but also the heavy burden of a tarnished legacy. While youth shields Eng Roger Mortimer 2Nd Earl Of March for now, the crown of England watches the young heir with a wary eye.

Will the Mortimer dynasty fade into noble obscurity as mere landowners, or will they reclaim the lofty influence once wielded on both sides of the march?

desc: t

Maj Raden Wijaya established the powerful Kingdom of Majapahit across the coasts of Indonesia. After Maj Raden Wijaya death, maj_jayanagara assumed the royal duties, but proved to be an ineffective leader whose rule was plagued with much internal and external strife, as well as open rebellions that contested royal authority.

Fortunately, maj_jayanagara's assassination in 1328 left the reins of the country in the capable hands of maj_tribhuwana, as Majapahit for Maj Tribhuwana son, Maj Hayam Wuruk. The start of Maj Tribhuwana regency marked the beginning of a new era for the people of Majapahit, under the watchful and capable eye of Maj Gajah Mada, who currently serves as ''Mahapatih'' - vice-England.

It has become apparent that under the rule of such capable leaders, the future looks bright for this Majapahit and its subjects. This could truly be the beginning of a golden age for Majapahit!

The mighty Mal Musa Keita of Mali astonished the world a decade ago, when he performed his ''Ḥajj'' ('pilgrimage') to Mecca. During the journey, Mal Musa Keita spent gold generously in service of the faith, building houses of worship and gaining brilliant new subjects as Mal Musa Keita traveled. Such an extraordinary event was recorded by chroniclers and heralded by minstrels, and it served to establish his fame as the richest man in the world as he performed his ''Al-Zakāh Wājib'' ('almsgiving') wherever his long and luxurious courtly caravan passed by.

This display of splendor reflected the incomparable riches of Mali after its Mali had expanded and consolidated under the Mali dynasty, and helped create vast trade routes. However, one day Mal Musa Keita will pass away, and his successors may not find it so easy to rule over his mythic wealth and highly diverse holdings...

desc: t

Forged in the fires of revolution and sustained by the swords of warrior-slaves traded from the Caucasus, the Mamlūks rose from the collapse of the Ayyubids. Under infamous leaders such as Mam Baybars II, they halted the Mongol advance near Nablus at the battle of 'Ayn Jālūt, and conquered the last Crusader strongholds of the Kingdom of Jerusalem. Now the Kingdom of Egypt (MAM) stands as the preeminent Islam power in the Eastern Mediterranean Sea, ruling Egypt and Levant from the splendid capital of Cairo.

Legitimized by these victories, their protection of the Holy Sites of Mecca and Madīna, a shadow Caliph installed in Cairo, and further enriched by trade, the reign of Mam An Nasir Bahri has brought rare stability. However, the survival of the Egypt (MAM) depends on the loyalty of its fractious military elite, and the looming succession crisis that regularly threatens to unmake this strong state.

desc: t

The Heartland of the Holy Roman Empire has endured the long period of the Great Interregnum, and looks to the future with grave concern. In the face of Ubv Ludwig IV Wittelsbach's advancing age, the families of Upper Bavaria, Bohemia, and Austria once more prepare for competition over the crown. While Imperial authority south of the Alps is deteriorating, German merchants scramble to secure their trade routes into Italy, as the Duchy of Hansa relish their dominance over the region of Northern Germany.

The County of Meissen, a possession of the powerful Meissen dynasty, originated in an eastern march of the Holy Roman Empire, in the lands where Sorbs and other Slavic people were slowly Germanized over time. The land, originally densely forested, has proven to be very fertile, and the mild climate, especially near the Elbe river, has allowed the Saxons living there to develop a Wine culture.

The Ore Mountains, separating the country from the Bohemian, are rich in minerals, especially the Silver that fuels the economy of the Meissen. However, its abundance is a double-edged sword, we are viewed with greedy eyes by neighboring societies, who may very well try to conquer us. Despite these potential threats and the increased instability caused by the Great Interregnum, Meissen thrives as a significant Imperial territory in Upper Saxony. Giving the waning authority in rural Thuringia and Brandenburg, the Wettin could emerge as a new power in the eastern Empire, expanding their influence and safeguarding their holdings against external pressures.

With our fertile lands, rich resources, and strategic location, we stand as a prominent entity in the Holy Roman Empire, attracting admiration and envy from our neighbors.
entities.name: Meissen

The politics of the Italian Peninsula are a double-edged sword. Foes and friends, allies and rivals... all are but identities, put on and taken off as easily as a gilded mask, and Milan is no different. Centered around the strong urban center of Milan, we seek to project our strength on our newly conquered territories around us, whilst also protecting ourselves against traitors to the east and west. Internally, the rise of autonomous city-states will likely cause issues for our administration and the preservation of our sovereignty. In short, threats surround us like daggers in the night.

Despite the dangers, however, the Milanese position in this hostile environment is quite advantageous. We stand to gain an inconceivable amount of glory and prestige, should we succeed in quelling both internal and external dangers, provided we have a strong and united leadership to guide us.

The Maghreb has witnessed the rise and fall of many dynasties and one powerful Morocco after another, from the Idrisids to the Almoravids to the Almohads. But this era of instability and uncertainty finally ended under the Marinid dynasty and the rule of Mor Abu Al Hasan Ali. Through a careful balance of military might and diplomatic acumen, we have at last secured firm control within our borders.

Now our ambitions turn eastward, where we seek to challenge the dominance of the Zayyanid of Tlemcen. And, to the north, we hold a strategic foothold across the Strait of Gibraltar, from  Algeciras to  Ronda, where we stand in solidarity with our brothers in faith of Granada in a common effort against the Christianity rulers of Iberia. Our way forward will not be easy, but we have the power and determination to face whatever obstacles we must overcome.

desc: t

The Kingdom of Muscovy stands at a crossroads of political maneuvering, economic troubles under the Tatar Yoke, and an ongoing power struggle among East Slavic principalities, each vying for supremacy within the fragmented Rus' territories. The Tatar invasion continues to cast a long shadow over the region and Muscovy, like many other Rus' principalities, remains a tributary to the formidable Jochi.

Guiding Muscovy through these complexities is Muscovy, a leader keenly aware of the delicate balance required for survival under Tatar dominion. Muscovy has skillfully managed the principality's affairs through diplomatic initiatives and strategic alliances and now seeks to consolidate power and enhance Muscovy's standing within the Yoke, with aspirations to unite the Rus' land under one banner.

desc: t

The Kingdom of Naples stands at the crossroads of its own troubled history. Born from the ambitions of powerful dynasties seeking dominion over the lands of southern Italy, Naples rises as a bastion of resilience and cultural fusion that extends from ancient civilizations such as the Greeks and Romans, to the more recent dynasties of the Hauteville, Hohenstaufen, and Anjou, each leaving an indelible mark on Neapolitan identity.

In the year 1337, the Kingdom finds itself under the rule of a visionary leader, Naples. A wise and just ruler known for Naples sagacity and keen judgment, Naples has navigated the intricate web of political alliances with finesse. Naples rule has brought a period of relative peace and a welcome respite from the turbulence of the past.

What will become of Naples when Naples steady hand falters? What will Naples successor do to stave off all those who covet the Neapolitan lands? The tale of Naples's future is as yet unwritten...

desc: t

Originally founded by Nav Inigo Arista around the city of Pamplona as ''the Kingdom of Pamplona'', the Kingdom of Navarre has left its glorious days behind, now being territorially limited between big neighbors that look upon its lands with ravenous greed. Born as a Basque march of the Carolingian Empire, the realm has witnessed the rise and fall of local dynasties and their replacement by Francien ones, which have tipped the fate of the realm inevitably towards the Kingdom of France.

Without open paths of expansion and laboring under so much cultural pressure, will the Kingdom of Navarre be able to resist the more powerful surrounding nations and recover its past glory?

desc: t

Originally founded by Slavic and Norse people as ''Holmgård'', the 'new city' of Novgorod became the main political and economic center in the northern lands inhabited by the East Slavic people. Fiercely independent, the Novgorodian Velikiy Novgorod elects its Velikiy Novgorod from among neighboring rulers, although the true power is held by its people, who thrive thanks to lucrative commercial routes linking the rich inland resource-gathering outposts to the Baltic and White Seas.

However, in recent decades, the war with Sweden has been almost a constant, although it has been halted by the creation of the buffer state of Oreshek. Meanwhile, to the south, Muscovy has become a dominant power, with the backing of the Kingdom of Jochi. The proud inhabitants of Novgorod may soon find themselves at a crossroads, compelled to make difficult — yet crucial — decisions in order to protect their home.

desc: t

After a long period of peace under the Kamakura Shogunate, the islands of Japan were plunged again into war during the Mongol invasions. That debilitated the authority of the Shōgun to the point where Daikakuji was able to wrest control of the country away from him. However, Daikakuji intentions of restoring Imperial rule were not to come to fruition, as Daikakuji former ally Ashikaga(JAP) established a new Japanese Shogunate instead.

Now Ashikaga(JAP) has installed Jimyōin as Ashikaga(JAP) own Jimyōin in Jimyōin, but again as a mere puppet, subject to the ultimate authority of the Japanese Shogunate.

desc: t

The Heartland of the Holy Roman Empire has endured the long period of the Great Interregnum, and looks to the future with grave concern. In the face of Ubv Ludwig IV Wittelsbach's advancing age, the families of Upper Bavaria, Bohemia, and Austria once more prepare for competition over the crown. While Imperial authority south of the Alps is deteriorating, German merchants scramble to secure their trade routes into Italy, as the Duchy of Hansa relish their dominance over the region of Northern Germany.

With the Treaty of Pavia having secured the independence and an electorate for the County of Rhine, Pal Rudolf II Wittelsbach will now need to focus Pal Rudolf II Wittelsbach efforts on solidifying Pal Rudolf II Wittelsbach split territory. On the banks of the Rhine River is the political center of Rhine, with its fertile soils and wealthy traders passing through, while the so-called ''Upper Palatinate'' presents a close connection to our Rhine roots in Bavaria.

Wherever the focus of Rhine might fall, the country must overcome the challenges of their regional rivals if they aspire not to be at the mercy of even stronger foes.

desc: t

Since its creation by the hand of Saint Peter himself, the Catholicism Church has guided humanity to salvation through the ages under the leadership of the bishop of Rome, the Rome. Starting with the ''Donation of Pepin'', Rome came into being with the intent of both governing and aiding the faithful.

However, the last few decades have been a constant struggle. The death of Pap Boniface VIII forced the court to relocate to the exclave of Avignon, where we fell under the influence of Fra Philippe IV Capet. As well, our holdings in Italy have become dominated by quarreling noble families.

What should the vicar of Christ do to resolve this exceptional situation? Will Rome fully become a puppet of the Kingdom of France, and allow the temporal to rule over the spiritual? Or will Rome break free and rise to the position at the top of Creation, which Rome intended for the Church?

desc: t

Pale stands as the last firm outpost of England's authority in Ireland. Ruled from Dublin castle, it clings to the eastern coast, cut off from the rest of the island with a network of palisade defenses from which it gets its name.

But it is the disparate Anglo-Irish earls, coralled as they are by our Lordship of Ireland, who truly wield the power beyond the Pale. In the years of living in the Gaelic wildlands, the earls have become entangled with the native Irish lords, and they drift further by the year.

Still, Dublin remains a dignified center of English governance, law, and trade. Its appointed lieutenants attempt to uphold the king's peace, while the impotent Parliament of Ireland gathers to enact statutes that struggle to reach beyond the stone walls of the castle.

Will the Lordship of Ireland reclaim its former reach, asserting control over the whole island? Or will it remain a coastal remnant — besieged, shrinking, and increasingly irrelevant — as Gaelic lords and marcher earls divide the emerald isle between them?

desc: t

For centuries, the Kingdom of Poland has found itself amid dynastic successions, wars, and fluctuating borders. The current ruler, Pol Casimir III Piast, started his energetic reign in 1333, but despite his unification attempts, many of the Polish subjects remain defiant in an effort to safeguard their cherished autonomy against the new Poland's diplomatic maneuvers. Nonetheless, eager to introduce legislative and social changes of relevance, Pol Casimir III Piast has already established the rights of the Judaism minority as well as the Polish Poland, earning Poland the title 'Peasant Poland'.

However, the war against the Duchy of Teutons rages on, with Pol Casimir III Piast fighting along Lit Gediminas Gediminids against their common enemy, trying to regain their occupied lands.

Will Poland be able to establish a long-lasting peace on the border with the Duchy of Teutons? Will Poland to be able to continue Poland internal reforms? Or will the war continue to ravage the Polish?

The Kingdom of Portugal won its independence after a long and hard-fought struggle against both the Islam and Christianity rulers of the Iberia Region. After enacting the important social, economic, and cultural reforms promoted by Por Dinis I Portugal, his son and successor, Por Afonso IV Portugal may now face different challenges and opportunities while ruling over the Portuguese people.

To the west and south lies the wide North Atlantic Ocean and the promise of new trade routes with foreign lands, while to the east the powerful Crown of Castile, with strong dynastic connections to Portugal, could one day lead to a united Iberia under Portuguese leadership.

Whatever the future holds, Portugal will need to secure its position one way or another to ensure its future as an independent country.

desc: t

Scotland is once again in peril.

A mere generation ago, our national hero, Sco Robert The Bruce, freed us from the English rule, alongside the famous martyr, William Wallace.

Now his successor — the bairn Sco David II — lies exiled in France as our loyal nobility continues their struggle against Balliol, the English king's lackey state that falsely claims the Scottish crown.

Though the people of our Scotland are currently united in our cause, this is not guaranteed to last. Embedded in our kingdom are deep cultural and societal divisions, especially between the wealthy English-speaking Scots burghs of the lowlands and the Highland people who dwell in the inland hills.

Long ago, Roman invaders built a wall against us, so fearsome was the Scottish reputation. Perhaps it is time to reinvigorate that ancient ferocity...

desc: t

Serbia encompasses fertile lowlands and plains in the north, crisscrossed by the mighty Danube and Sava rivers. In the south, the landscape transforms into rugged, forested terrain and, eventually, the towering Dinaric Alps.

Serbia emerged as a significant regional power under the Nemanjić dynasty. Founded by Stefan Nemanja in the 12th century, this royal lineage laid the foundations for a unified Serbian state, began to solidify its Christianity Orthodoxy identity, and sought to establish ecclesiastical autonomy. This effort culminated in 1219 when the Serbian Orthodoxy Church gained independence.

Under the rule of Stefan 'the First-Crowned', Serbia's territorial expansion accelerated, and the acquisition of coastal regions on the Adriatic Sea secured access to maritime trade and introduced Western influences. Stefan's son, King Radoslav, promoted the country's cultural development, fostering education and art, and monasteries like Studenica and Žiča flourished, housing precious religious manuscripts and frescoes.

Despite the many recent advancements, Serbia now faces external pressures and internal divisions. The Mongol invasion in the 13th century inflicted significant damage and conflict within the ruling Nemanjić family, particularly between Ser Stefan Milutin and his brother Ser Stefan Dragutin, further weakening the state's unity. But perhaps the tide is turning, as the strong rule of Ser Stefan Dusan has begun, giving Ser Stefan Dusan the opportunity to change the tides of history.

desc: t

The Thai people migrated from South China to Indochina centuries ago, where they discovered a land crossed by trade and influences from both India and China. Drinking from both sources, as well as from the presence of Hinduism and Buddhism, the Thai developed its own unique identity, creating polities that are able to stand on equal footing to those by the former rulers, the Mon people, who have seen their territory reduced and many of their old kingdoms supplanted by Thai ones. This has also caused the Empire of Khmer to slip into decline, and they have subsequently lost much of its previous influence. Only time can tell to what further heights the Thai will be able to reach.

One of the Mon kingdoms that suffered a downfall was Lavo, which was not only conquered by the Thai but also split into the Thai kingdoms of Suphanburi and Lavo. The latter, although they retained their name from the Mon period, was under Thai rule, which was itself under the suzerainty of the Empire of Khmer.

However, Empire of Khmer has waned in power in recent years, which not only enabled the creation of an independent Kingdom of Sukhothai, but also allowed Lavo to remove its shackles. In the midst of these nascent independent kingdoms, the developing settlement of Ayodhya also shows promise of expansion. The opportunity for great change has finally appeared to us.
entities.name: Suphanburi

desc: t

After a long period of peace under the Kamakura Shogunate, the islands of Japan were plunged again into war during the Mongol invasions. That debilitated the authority of the Shōgun to the point where Daikakuji was able to wrest control of the country away from him. However, Daikakuji intentions of restoring Imperial rule were not to come to fruition, as Daikakuji former ally Ashikaga(JAP) established a new Japanese Shogunate instead.

Essentially living in forced exile from the capital, Daikakuji finds Daikakuji in the position of having to gather support for Daikakuji cause if Daikakuji is to survive and challenge the authority of the Japanese Shogunate once again. The time has come to rise — or fall.
entities.name: Daikakuji

desc: t

The Kingdom of Sweden is a feudal Sweden under the rule of Swe Magnus Eriksson, who also holds the crown of Norway. The Kingdom of Scania was bought from the impoverished Danish just a few years ago. Our territory is vast, but sparsely populated, and mostly covered by dense forests. Deep in those woods, riches of Iron and Copper remain hidden, waiting to be used to enrich our country.

Our Sweden currently faces grave challenges, fallout from our recent clash with the mercantile power Duchy of Velikiy Novgorod over Ingria. Meanwhile, the Kingdom of Denmark and the Duchy of Teutons control most of the lands to the south — lands that we could govern and exploit with much more finesse.

Sweden is positioned to be one of the foremost nations in the world. Will we be able to defeat our challenges, take our rightful place of power, and establish the ''Dominium Maris Baltici'' - the Dominion over the Baltic Sea?

desc: t

The glorious ''Order of Brothers of the German House of Saint Mary in Jerusalem'', also known as the Duchy of Teutons, face their destiny on the stormy coasts of the Baltic Sea. Created to protect the Christianity pilgrims on their way to the Holy City of Jerusalem, its objective shifted to Christianize the Pagan tribes of Prussia and the Baltic through the creation of a state in those lands.

Under the leadership of our predecessor, Teu Werner Von Orseln, the Duchy of Teutons expanded its territorial holdings, but this expansion has not come without consequences. The Order's aggressive policies have created powerful enemies, as the Pagan tribes to the East have united against us and formed the Duchy of Lithuania. Worse, they then allied with our Catholicism southern neighbor and rival, the Kingdom of Poland, which has abandoned its Christianity duty and joined with the Pagans against us.

The time has come for our Order to prove that we are up to the crusading task that we have set for ourselves, and show the world that even surrounded by enemies, our faith stands triumphant.

Our new realm of Thomond, guarding the mouth of the great River Shannon, sits vulnerable. We are surrounded by powerful lords and tense relationships, both of ancient Irish kingdoms and the new Anglo-Irish Earldoms.

Will we reclaim our righteous title as Kings of Munster, or will we go further and once again unite the High Kingship under the banner of O Brien Dynasty?

desc: t

For the past two centuries, groups of Nahua people descended from the Chichimec migrated to central Mexico from their legendary ancestral home, known as Aztlan. Our people were one of those wandering groups. As with many other Nahua nations, we established our own Āltepētl called Tenōchtitlan, which was built on an artificial island in the heart of Lake Texcoco.

Our most prominent figures were also influenced by the Toltec culture, and as a result, we have developed a refined and sophisticated civilization, cradled in the lagoon. We are also recognized as skilled fighters by our neighbors, as our equally refined battle skills have made the armies of the Aztecs, the descendants of Aztlan, a force to be feared...

However, we currently stand as vassals of the Āltepētl of Tepanecapan, and as such, our expansion possibilities are limited to the areas around the lagoon we inhabit. Only a brilliant and capable ruler could possibly lead the Aztecs in our journey to subdue the Valley of Mexico and conquer lands beyond — could it be Tenōchtitlan?

desc: t

The last vestige of a once-powerful dynasty, the Trebizond now rule over the Empire of Trebizond, gazing across the Black Sea. Having witnessed the rise and fall of the Nicean Empire, as the Turkic raiders reign across Anatolia, Tre Basil Komnenos now depends on a shaky alliance with Byzantium to weather the storm. At the same time, merchants from Genoa have all but monopolized the trade influx that passes through Crimea and the Black Sea, siphoning much coin from the coffers of Trapezuntine. The marriage to the illegitimate daughter of Byz Andronikos III Palaiologos has gone cold, and the situation in the capital grows even more dire under the pressure of southern raids and internal conflicts with the Scholarioi...

Be it through cunning, gold, or force, we must tighten our trembling grasp on power if we are to preserve everything we have fought for.

desc: t

The Beylik of the Ottomans was founded by tur_osman, a chieftain of the Kayı tribe of the Oghuz Turks, around 1299. Occupying the Northwestern coast region of Anatolia, they were initially one of the many Beyliks to occupy the border territory of Rûm, a once-powerful Sultanate. Under the leadership of tur_orhan, they have consolidated and greatly expanded their domain, securing vital land along the coast of the Bosphorus. Bountiful raids, military victories, and cunning diplomacy have set them apart as one of the region's most powerful rising Beyliks. Adaptive and innovative, our culture is a unique blend of regional ways and mores, where religious tolerance and strategic incorporation of conquered peoples make our society a brilliant mosaic of humanity.

The Beylik of the Ottomans is the ultimate example of sophisticated civilization, but that does not mean we are safe from all harm. Internal strife caused by friction between autonomous tribes and a series of succession crises concerns us, as does the persistent threat represented by our Byzantine and Ilkhanate neighbors, to say nothing of rival Beyliks.

Yet, despite these dogs nipping at our heels, we march proudly towards the future. Whether it is a future of conquest, diplomacy, trade, or art is yet to be determined...

The Heartland of the Holy Roman Empire has endured the long period of the Great Interregnum, and looks to the future with grave concern. In the face of Ubv Ludwig IV Wittelsbach's advancing age, the families of Upper Bavaria, Bohemia, and Austria once more prepare for competition over the crown. While Imperial authority south of the Alps is deteriorating, German merchants scramble to secure their trade routes into Italy, as the Duchy of Hansa relish their dominance over the region of Northern Germany.

Under the Leadership of Ubv Ludwig IV Wittelsbach, Bavaria is now at the height of its power. As Ubv Ludwig IV Wittelsbach is the Emperor of the Holy Roman Empire, the Duchy of Upper Bavaria commands particular respect and authority among the Imperial leaders. While the Duchy of Lower Bavaria is currently ruled by Lbv Heinrich XIV Wittelsbach, his health is steadily declining due to leprosy, and Lbv Heinrich XIV Wittelsbach predicted early death could spark a reunification of Bavaria.

Given the strong relationships between the Upper Bavaria rulers of Europe, Bavaria is ready to claim its right to rule the Holy Roman Empire and exert its authority over central Europe, challenging their rivals in Bohemia and Austria.
entities.name: Upper Bavaria

desc: t

The once proud County of Ulster is in shatters. In 1333, Uls William Donn De Burgh 3Rd Earl Ulster was murdered, leaving the infant Uls Elizabeth De Burgh 4Th Countess Ulster as the sole heir. The junior Burgh clans of Clanricarde, Mayo, and Clanwilliam have taken advantage of our weakness, and now compete amongst each other for control over all the family lands.

Meanwhile, the feuding Neill chieftains of Tyrone and Clandeboye lay waste our rightful territory, exploiting our misfortune.

The weakened crown administration of Pale is beset by troubles, and is too weak to interfere; for now, we can only bide our time from the safety of the impregnable fortress of Carrickfergus. Will we fade into obscurity, or regain our position as the preeminent Anglo-Irish power?
entities.name: Ulster

desc: t

The nations in the Low Countries have been bounded and bossed around by both the Kingdom of France or the Holy Roman Empire since their creation, often becoming a fief of one or the other and not rarely switching sides. Like a big prize waiting for a claimant, as one of the richest regions in Europe, the countries of the region are in a position where they have to decide whether they will become an integral part of other nations or will defend their independence with fury.

Harassed for too long by the County of Guelders and the County of Holland, the County of Utrecht is trying to shake off their influence and unite all the Low Countries under our divinely favored guidance. The bustling city of Utrecht, a center of culture and art, would make an excellent capital for a unified region. Let us hope that others agree... preferably without too much resistance.
entities.name: Utrecht

desc: t

The Most Serene Republic of Venice is the most important and powerful merchant republic in the Mediterranean Sea. It controls important trade ports and islands which form the ''Stado do Mar'', and many inland territories in the North of Italy, which form the ''Domini di Terraferma''. Flush with prosperity from its extensive trade network, Venice is a beacon of wealth and culture, a lagoon-cradled jewel shining in the Adriatic Sea.

Nonetheless, this elegant city cannot lower its guard, as new threats arise around it. In the East, the once-great Empire of Byzantium will not easily forget the Fourth Crusade, nor the Venetian involvement in it. In the West, the Duchy of Genoa and the Crown of Aragon continue to expand their influence, conquering more territory and dominating trade routes. Finally, the County of Verona have become a palpable threat to the ''Domini di Terraferma''.

What will the future hold for the Venice? Will it fall under the pressure of its enemies, or will it rise to the top and become the indisputable ruler of the ''Mare Nostrum''?
entities.name: Venice

The newly founded Kingdom of Vijayanagar stands strong after the momentous defeat of Dehlavi troops in the Deccan, when Vij Harihara Sangama and his brother Vij Bukka Raya Sangama lead the fight against the Islam rulers of India.

Although Vijayanagari rule has only recently been established, the current situation in the Deccan promises us a rapid rise to power if we can utilize our momentum correctly, as we can secure control over important trade routes between China and Europe, and profit of exporting valuable goods from our resource-rich lands.

Vijayanagar is on the verge of a monumental step forward. Will we stumble, or proudly stand above the rest?

desc: t

The Welsh people descend from the ancient Celtic inhabitants of Britain; their domain stretched from the misty northern highlands to the rugged chalk cliffs of the southern coast. A land of fae and poets, of rain and sea, Wales was extraordinary in many ways. But Welsh dominion over their native lands could not be sustained.

First, the Anglo-Saxon warlords came, filling the power vacuum left by the fallen Roman Empire, and pushing the natives to the rocky peripheries of Britannia. Then came the Norman adventurers, who finally subjugated them and dethroned their rightful rulers.

Today, our fortified administration rules at the behest of the English England, with authority over the Anglo-Norman marches of the southern valleys and the Welsh settlements of the northern mountains.

But beneath the songs of our musicians and the steady drum of rain, there lies a murmur of rebellion. Will Wales be led to prosperity in the name of the Plantagenet kings, or will the Land of Our Fathers rise again? We are still here!
entities.name: Wales

desc: t

The Kingdom of Kilwa is firmly established as a powerful maritime state along the Swahili Coast, having expanded its influence over a vast swath of the Indian Ocean trade network. For more than a century, Kilwa's rulers capitalized on their strategic position, controlling the lucrative trade routes that connected Africa, Arabia, India, and even China.

Their wealth is built on the exchange of gold from the interior of Africa, as well as Ivory, Slaves, and other local goods for luxury items such as Farsi silks, Indian textiles, and Chinese porcelain. Kilwa's prosperity is reflected in the grandeur of its architecture, which symbolizes Kilwan power and sophistication.

But our prosperity cannot protect us from everything. Even now, the masters of Zimbabwe are consolidating their power to the Southwest, as competition in foreign markets grows ever fiercer.

What mysteries does the future hold for the Kilwa? Only time will tell.
entities.name: Kilwa

desc: t

Controlling the great riches of Southeast Africa, the Kingdom of Zimbabwe enjoys a period of stability and peace. Trade with merchants from the Swahili Coast is flourishing and ensures the steady supply of foreign goods from as far away as India and China, while the mines of the African interior seem to offer a never-ending supply of riches. Our capital, the largest city in the region, is renowned far and wide for its glorious edifices of stone, which will stand forever as testaments to Zimbabwe achievement.

Despite all this, however, trouble stalks our great nation. We cannot rely forever on our resources, and our arid climate often leads to failed harvests. Our population is relatively small. And, while we are a major trading power, the balance could slip at any moment to favor another if we are not careful. We also struggle with external threats from our covetous neighbors.

What will become of this promising nation? Can Zimbabwe overcome its numerous barriers and realize its potential as the leader of the entire Swahili Coast? Or will it be torn apart by the twin jackals of external and internal conflict?
entities.name: Zimbabwe
